en: It is not until we lose our health that we realize how precious it is.
zh: 直到失去健康，我们才意识到它有多么宝贵。
usage: 强调句 not until，适合开头点题或结尾警示

en: Only by stepping out of our comfort zone can we discover how much potential we really have.
zh: 只有走出舒适区，我们才能发现自己真正的潜力有多大。
usage: Only by 倒装，适合论证段或结尾鼓劲

en: There is no denying that technology has brought us convenience, but it has also quietly taken away our patience.
zh: 不可否认，科技给我们带来了便利，但它也悄然带走了我们的耐心。
usage: 让步转折，科技类作文万能开头

en: What matters most in learning is not how much we memorize, but how well we can apply it.
zh: 学习中最重要的不是记住多少，而是能多好地运用。
usage: not...but...，适合论述学习方法

en: As the saying goes, "Rome was not built in a day," and neither is any meaningful achievement.
zh: 俗话说“罗马不是一天建成的”，任何有意义的成就也是如此。
usage: 引言 + 递进，适合坚持类论证

en: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, the line between human creativity and machine efficiency is becoming blurred.
zh: 随着人工智能的快速发展，人类创造力与机器效率之间的界线正变得模糊。
usage: With 结构开头，AI 话题快速切入

en: While enjoying the convenience of the digital age, we should also stay alert to the risk of losing our privacy.
zh: 在享受数字时代便利的同时，我们也应对隐私流失的风险保持警惕。
usage: While doing 让步，双刃剑型论证

en: Compared with material wealth, inner peace is far more difficult to obtain and far more worth pursuing.
zh: 与物质财富相比，内心的平静更难获得，也更值得追求。
usage: Compared with 比较，价值观类结尾

en: It goes without saying that reading broadens our horizons and enriches our inner world.
zh: 毋庸置疑，阅读开阔我们的视野，丰富我们的内心世界。
usage: 万能论点句，阅读类作文开头

en: Were it not for the support of my teachers, I would never have come this far.
zh: 如果没有老师们的支持，我绝不可能走到今天。
usage: 虚拟条件倒装，适合感恩 / 记叙结合

en: Not only does volunteering help those in need, but it also gives us a sense of purpose.
zh: 志愿服务不仅帮助了需要帮助的人，也让我们找到了意义感。
usage: Not only 部分倒装 + 递进，公益类

en: What deserves our attention is that many young people are sacrificing sleep for short-term productivity.
zh: 值得我们注意的是，许多年轻人正在用睡眠换取短期效率。
usage: What deserves our attention，现象类开头

en: Faced with fierce competition, graduates are supposed to improve their practical skills rather than merely collect certificates.
zh: 面对激烈竞争，毕业生应提升实践能力，而不是仅仅收集证书。
usage: Faced with 分词状语，就业类论证

en: There is a growing awareness that environmental protection is not a burden but an investment in our future.
zh: 越来越多人意识到，环保不是负担，而是对未来的投资。
usage: There is a growing awareness，环保类开头

en: It is high time that we took concrete action to reduce plastic waste instead of merely talking about it.
zh: 我们该采取切实行动减少塑料垃圾了，而不是仅仅谈论它。
usage: It is high time + 过去式，结尾呼吁

en: Nothing is more rewarding than watching a child's eyes light up when he finally understands something.
zh: 没有什么比看到一个孩子终于弄懂问题时眼睛发亮更让人欣慰的了。
usage: Nothing is more...，教育价值类

en: The more we communicate face to face, the less we rely on screens to express our feelings.
zh: 我们越面对面交流，就越不依赖屏幕表达情感。
usage: the more...the more，对比论证

en: Instead of complaining about the unfairness of life, we had better ask ourselves what we can change.
zh: 与其抱怨生活的不公，不如问问自己能改变什么。
usage: Instead of 对比，心态 / 行动类

en: A person who never fails has probably never tried anything difficult.
zh: 一个从未失败过的人，大概从未尝试过困难的事。
usage: 定语从句，失败话题反证

en: Failure is not the opposite of success; it is part of success.
zh: 失败不是成功的对立面，而是成功的一部分。
usage: 短句对比，结尾金句

en: It is our choices, rather than our abilities, that shape who we are.
zh: 塑造我们的，是我们的选择，而不是我们的能力。
usage: 强调句 + rather than，价值观类

en: Although the road to success is long and bumpy, every small step counts.
zh: 尽管通往成功的路漫长而崎岖，但每一小步都有意义。
usage: Although 让步，结尾鼓励

en: Cultural heritage is not a relic to be locked in museums, but a living tradition to be passed on.
zh: 文化遗产不是锁在博物馆里的遗物，而是需要传承的活的传统。
usage: not...but... 并列结构，文化类

en: It would be a pity if traditional festivals were reduced to shopping promotions.
zh: 如果传统节日被简化成购物促销，那将是一种遗憾。
usage: 虚拟语气，传统节日类评述

en: Chinese calligraphy teaches us that beauty grows out of patience and practice.
zh: 中国书法告诉我们，美源自耐心与练习。
usage: that 从句做宾语，文化类举例

en: Globalization does not mean the loss of local identity; it means a dialogue between cultures.
zh: 全球化不意味着本土身份的丧失，而意味着文化间的对话。
usage: 分号对比，全球化论证

en: Learning a foreign language is more than memorizing words; it is learning to see the world through another pair of eyes.
zh: 学外语不只是记单词，而是学会用另一双眼睛看世界。
usage: more than 结构，语言学习类

en: Critical thinking enables us to question what we are told instead of accepting it blindly.
zh: 批判性思维让我们能质疑被告知的东西，而不是盲目接受。
usage: enables us to，教育目标类

en: It is essential for schools to teach students how to think rather than what to think.
zh: 学校教学生如何思考，而不是思考什么，这一点至关重要。
usage: It is essential for...to，教育观点

en: Cooperation is not about doing the same thing; it is about combining different strengths.
zh: 合作不是做同样的事，而是把不同的长处结合起来。
usage: 对比定义，合作类

en: A team without trust is like a ship without a compass.
zh: 没有信任的团队，就像没有指南针的船。
usage: 比喻句，团队话题段首

en: Self-discipline, in the long run, is a form of self-respect.
zh: 从长远看，自律是一种自尊。
usage: 插入语，自律类结尾

en: Time is the only currency that cannot be earned back once spent.
zh: 时间是唯一一种一旦花掉就再也赚不回来的货币。
usage: 定语从句 + 比喻，时间管理类

en: Managing time well is not about doing more, but about choosing what matters most.
zh: 管理好时间不是做更多的事，而是选择最重要的事。
usage: not about...but about，方法类论证

en: The best way to predict the future is to create it.
zh: 预测未来最好的办法，就是去创造它。
usage: 短句金句，结尾升华万能句

en: Innovation rarely comes from comfort; it comes from the courage to ask "why not?"
zh: 创新很少产生于安逸，而来自敢于问“为什么不行”的勇气。
usage: 分号对比 + 引号，创新类

en: Our generation is expected to turn challenges into opportunities.
zh: 我们这一代被期待把挑战转化为机遇。
usage: be expected to，青年责任类

en: Youth is not a period of life but a state of mind.
zh: 青春不是人生的一个阶段，而是一种心境。
usage: not...but...，青年话题结尾

en: Honesty may cost us in the short term, but it pays off in the long run.
zh: 诚实短期内可能让我们付出代价，但长远来看是值得的。
usage: 短长期对比，诚信类

en: Trust is easy to break and hard to rebuild.
zh: 信任易碎，且难以重建。
usage: 对称短句，诚信类收尾

en: Mental health deserves the same attention as physical health.
zh: 心理健康值得与身体健康同等的重视。
usage: deserves the same...as，心理健康类

en: Asking for help is a sign of strength, not weakness.
zh: 求助是坚强的表现，而非软弱。
usage: 对比短句，心理 / 成长类

en: Small acts of kindness can brighten someone's entire day.
zh: 小小的善举也能照亮别人的一整天。
usage: 日常善意类，适合举例段

en: Volunteer work reminds us that we are part of something larger than ourselves.
zh: 志愿服务提醒我们，我们属于比自己更大的事物。
usage: that 从句，公益类论证

en: Both cities and villages have their own charm, and neither should be sacrificed for the other.
zh: 城市与乡村各有魅力，不应为了一方牺牲另一方。
usage: neither...，城乡类平衡观点

en: Urbanization should not come at the price of disappearing villages.
zh: 城镇化不应以乡村消失为代价。
usage: at the price of，城乡 / 发展类

en: The family is where we learn our first lessons about love and responsibility.
zh: 家庭是我们学习爱与责任的第一课堂。
usage: where 定语从句，家庭类

en: Spare-time education is not just about grades; it is about discovering who our children are.
zh: 课外教育不只关乎成绩，更关乎发现孩子是谁。
usage: 分号对比，“双减”类话题

en: Consumerism tells us to buy happiness, but experience tells us to build it.
zh: 消费主义告诉我们要买幸福，而经验告诉我们要去构建幸福。
usage: 对称对比，消费观类

en: Spending money wisely is a skill that schools rarely teach.
zh: 理性花钱是一门学校很少教的技能。
usage: 定语从句，理财类

en: An aging society calls for both respect for the elderly and better public services.
zh: 老龄化社会既需要对老年人的尊重，也需要更好的公共服务。
usage: calls for both...and，老龄化类

en: Every senior citizen carries a chapter of history that deserves to be heard.
zh: 每一位老人都带着一段值得被倾听的历史。
usage: 定语从句，情感升华

en: Data has become the new oil, and our privacy is the price we may be paying for it.
zh: 数据已成为新的石油，而我们的隐私可能是为此付出的代价。
usage: 比喻 + 定语从句，数据隐私类

en: Social media connects us to the world, yet it may disconnect us from the people beside us.
zh: 社交媒体把我们与世界连接起来，却可能让我们与身边的人疏远。
usage: yet 转折对称，社交媒体类

en: The internet gives everyone a voice, but not everyone uses it responsibly.
zh: 互联网给了每个人发声的机会，但并非每个人都负责任地使用它。
usage: 转折，网络素养类

en: We should treat information on the internet with the same caution as we treat unknown food.
zh: 我们应对网络信息保持像对待陌生食物一样的谨慎。
usage: the same...as 比喻，信息素养类

en: Reading is a conversation with the wisest minds of the past.
zh: 阅读是与历史上最智慧的头脑对话。
usage: 比喻定义，阅读类开头

en: Books are the quiet teachers that never scold us for being slow.
zh: 书是安静的老师，从不因我们学得慢而责备我们。
usage: 比喻 + 定语从句，阅读类

en: Exercise is not a waste of study time; it is what makes study time effective.
zh: 锻炼不是浪费学习时间，而是让学习时间有效的关键。
usage: what 从句，健康 / 学习平衡

en: Sleep is not a luxury but a necessity for a sharp mind.
zh: 睡眠不是奢侈品，而是保持头脑敏锐的必需品。
usage: not...but，睡眠话题

en: The beauty of nature is not something we own, but something we borrow from our children.
zh: 自然之美不属于我们，而是我们从子孙那里借来的。
usage: not...but + 比喻，环保升华

en: Green development means meeting today's needs without robbing tomorrow of its chances.
zh: 绿色发展意味着满足今天的需求，而不剥夺明天的机会。
usage: without doing，可持续发展类

en: Technology is a good servant but a bad master.
zh: 科技是好的仆人，却是坏的主人。
usage: 经典对称句，科技类结尾

en: AI can imitate answers, but it cannot imitate the curiosity that produces questions.
zh: 人工智能可以模仿答案，却无法模仿产生问题的好奇心。
usage: but 转折，AI 与人文类

en: What machines cannot replace is our ability to care.
zh: 机器无法取代的，是我们关怀他人的能力。
usage: What 从句主语，AI 类升华

en: The gap between what we know and what we do is where most problems lie.
zh: 知道与做到之间的差距，正是大多数问题之所在。
usage: where 表语从句，知行合一类

en: Good habits are hard to build and easy to lose, while bad habits are the opposite.
zh: 好习惯难养成、易失去，坏习惯则恰恰相反。
usage: while 对比，习惯类

en: Our greatest glory is not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
zh: 我们最大的荣耀不在于从不跌倒，而在于每次跌倒后都能站起来。
usage: 名言式结尾，失败 / 坚持

en: If we want a better world, we must begin by being better people.
zh: 如果我们想要一个更好的世界，就必须从成为更好的人开始。
usage: If 条件 + 递进，责任类

en: A responsible citizen is one who does the right thing even when nobody is watching.
zh: 负责任的公民，是即使无人旁观也会做正确之事的人。
usage: 定语从句，责任类论证

en: Listening is often more powerful than speaking.
zh: 倾听往往比诉说更有力量。
usage: 短句对比，沟通类

en: Understanding begins the moment we stop assuming.
zh: 理解始于我们停止臆断的那一刻。
usage: the moment 引导时间状语，沟通类

en: Goals without deadlines are merely wishes.
zh: 没有期限的目标，不过是愿望而已。
usage: 短句判断，目标类

en: Progress is measured not by speed but by direction.
zh: 衡量进步的标准不是速度，而是方向。
usage: not by...but by，目标类

en: It is better to light a candle than to curse the darkness.
zh: 点亮一支蜡烛，胜过诅咒黑暗。
usage: It is better to...than to，行动类结尾

en: A country's strength lies not only in its economy but also in its culture.
zh: 一个国家的力量不仅在于经济，也在于文化。
usage: not only...but also，文化自信类

en: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
zh: 教育是你能用来改变世界的最有力武器。
usage: 名言，教育类开头或结尾

en: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
zh: 未来属于那些相信梦想之美的人。
usage: 名言式结尾，梦想 / 青年
